title: 기능성 양잠산업 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률 시행규칙

rows.text_en: Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs ( Green Bio-industry Team ), 044-201-2142, 2134

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「기능성 양잠산업 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Promotion and Support of the Functional Sericulture Industry and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(전문인력 양성기관 지정기준의 세부기준 등) ① 「기능성 양잠산업 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제6조제1항 각 호 외의 부분에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 지정신청서”란 별지 제1호서식의 전문인력 양성기관 지정신청서를 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Detailed Standards for Designation of Professional Training Institutions, etc.) ① In the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 6(1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Promotion and Support of the Functional Sericulture Industry (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”), the term “application for designation prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” refers to the application for designation of a professional training institution in the form of Annex No. 1.

rows.source_ko: ② 농촌진흥청장, 특별시장ㆍ광역시장ㆍ특별자치시장ㆍ도지사ㆍ특별자치도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장(자치구의 구청장을 말한다)은 영 제6조제1항에 따라 「기능성 양잠산업 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률」 제9조의3제2항에 따른 전문인력 양성기관(이하 “전문인력 양성기관”이라 한다)의 지정 신청을 받은 경우 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통해 법인 등기사항증명서(법인인 경우로 한정한다) 또는 사업자등록증명(주민등록번호가 제외된 사업자등록증명을 말한다. 이하 이 항에서 같다)을 확인해야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 사업자등록증명의 확인에 동의하지 않는 경우에는 해당 서류를 첨부하도록 해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② When the Administrator of the Rural Development Administration, the Mayor of a Special City, Metropolitan City, Special Self-Governing City, or the Governor of a Province or Special Self-Governing Province, or the Mayor, County Head, or District Head (referring to the District Head of a self-governing district) receives an application for designation of a professional personnel training institution (hereinafter referred to as “professional personnel training institution”) pursuant to Article 9-3, Paragraph 2 of the Act on the Promotion and Support of Functional Sericulture Industry in accordance with Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, they shall verify the Certificate of Corporate Registration (limited to cases where the applicant is a corporation) or the Certificate of Business Registration (referring to a Certificate of Business Registration excluding the resident registration number; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph) through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification of the Certificate of Business Registration, they must be required to attach the relevant document.

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제6조제2항에 따른 전문인력 양성기관 지정기준의 세부기준은 별표와 같다.
rows.text_en: ③ The detailed criteria for the designation of professional training institutions pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree are as set forth in the attached table.

rows.source_ko: ④ 영 제6조제3항에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 지정서”란 별지 제2호서식의 전문인력 양성기관 지정서를 말한다.
rows.text_en: ④ In Article 6 , Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, “designation certificate prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” refers to the designation certificate for professional personnel training institutions in Form No. 2 of the Appendix.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(규제의 재검토) 농림축산식품부장관은 제2조제3항 및 별표에 따른 전문인력 양성기관 지정기준의 세부기준에 대하여 2026년 1월 1일을 기준으로 3년마다(매 3년이 되는 해의 기준일과 같은 날 전까지를 말한다) 그 타당성을 검토하여 개선 등의 조치를 해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Review of Regulations) The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall review the validity of the detailed standards for the designation of professional personnel training institutions pursuant to Article 2, Paragraph 3 and the attached table every three years starting from January 1, 2026 (meaning until the day before the same date as the reference date of every third year) and take measures such as improvements.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Decree No. 732, Aug. 22, 2025>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
